tasks.behavior: A store's logo and color brand its pay page and PDFs
acceptance: PUT /v1/profiles/{profileId}/stores/{storeId}/logo keeps a PNG or JPEG (at most 1 MB, 1024 px a side) as a PNG of the same pixels; SVG, other formats and larger images are 422; DELETE removes it; GET /v1/stores/{storeId}/logo.png serves it publicly, 404 logo_not_found without one; owner routes are 403 for another user and 404 store_not_found for another profile's store
A store saves brandColor (#rrggbb or none) and reads back logoAt; invoice reads return brand {storeId, color, logoAt} for a merchant invoice and null otherwise

The pay page shows the store's logo in place of the payee's initial tile and the color as that box's edge; the invoice and receipt PDFs show the logo in the header in place of Forwend's and the color on the header rule
Edit store uploads, previews and removes the logo and sets the color; axe finds 0 serious or critical violations on Edit store and the branded pay page
R-135, api.md, openapi.yaml, the architecture docs, DESIGN.md and web/structure.md describe it; required checks and a11y-e2e pass
notes: 2026-10-24 review fail by reviewer: BLOCKING: (1) apps/backend/internal/profile/store_logo.go:99 with migrations/00059_store_branding.sql:6 caps the re-encoded PNG at 1 MiB, so uploads that meet R-135 (<=1 MB, <=1024 px) are refused 422. Repro: a 135 KB 1024x1024 photo-like JPEG re-encodes (same NRGBA+png.Encode path) to 1.42 MB. A palette PNG that becomes truecolor hits the same cap. The 422 message and the web copy (COPY.errors.logo) name limits the file already meets, so the owner cannot fix it. This breaks accept 1, R-135, api.md and openapi. No test covers it. Fix: allow the kept PNG's worst case for 1024 px (DB check too), or define and document a separate limit with its own error. NON-BLOCKING: (2) docs/PROJECT.md:187 R-135's first sentence is 37 words, and openapi.yaml:391-393 is 26 (D-84). (3) openapi.yaml:392 and docs/backend/api.md:181 say '8-bit with alpha'; Go writes an opaque logo as 8-bit RGB (color type 2). (4) openapi.yaml:2544 InvoiceSummary.required lacks brand, though it is always sent; web invoices.ts:109 uses .nullish() while its comment says 'in every answer'. (5) No test asserts CSP default-src 'none' or nosniff on GET /v1/stores/{id}/logo.png, so removing them fails nothing. (6) e2e/pay.spec.ts:644-655 asserts border colors and naturalWidth; web/rules.md says colors are judged in screenshots. Keep the axe part. (7) docs/web/architecture.md:72-74: the existing over-long 'Features import each other' sentence grew. (8) In dark mode a transparent dark logo sits on a dark bg-surface box (pay page, Edit store preview) and can vanish. JPEG EXIF orientation is dropped. Checked and fine: owner routes use ProfileScoped; setLogo filters by profile_id; the public route serves only API-encoded PNG with image/png, CSP, nosniff and an ETag. DecodeConfig dimension and format checks run before Decode. Color is validated by regex and a DB CHECK (lowercase) and by zod before React style. Migration Down is fine. The statement PDF path is unchanged (open(...,nil)). RTK File body and tag invalidation are fine; currentData keeps the form mounted. No cross-feature import cycle. The raw-controls list is updated. TestStoreBranding and TestStores pass; go build/vet are clean; document tests pass; docs-check reports 0 errors.
